name: Bevy WASM (Fast Startup)
updateContentCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y pkg-config libx11-dev libasound2-dev libudev-dev libwayland-dev libxkbcommon-dev lld clang
postCreateCommand: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && TRUNK_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/trunk-rs/trunk/releases/latest | grep 'tag_name' | cut -d'"' -f4) && curl -sSL "https://github.com/trunk-rs/trunk/releases/download/${TRUNK_VERSION}/trunk-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" | sudo tar -xzf - -C /usr/local/bin/
